newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss investment forum starts in Crans Montana.
newsitem.headline: Swiss investment forum starts in Crans Montana.

text.p: Business and political leaders gathered in the Swiss mountain resort of Crans Montana on Thursday at the start of a four-day annual international forum.
The meeting will focus on investment in eastern Europe, the former Soviet Union including Central Asia, north Africa and the Middle East, organisers said.
The forum attracts company executives seeking a chance to meet politicians and government officials to discuss energy, infrastructure, telecommunications and other business deals.

In addition to officials from Central Asia and several former Soviet Baltic republics, Palestinian President Yasser Arafat was also among billed attendees. But Palestinian diplomats in Geneva had no confirmation that Arafat was coming.
